description.value: The Dayton Audio SS12-PR 12" Signature Series Passive Radiator makes it easy to achieve extended low-frequency performance from compact enclosures, making it the ideal partner for the SS12-22 subwoofer. With the same heavy-duty cast aluminum frame, anodized aluminum cone, and rubber surround as its powered counterpart, the SS12-PR provides the excursion capability needed to complement today’s high-output drivers. Thanks to Dayton Audio’s Sandwich Mass Structure (SMS) tuning system, adjusting and securing the added mass is quick, accurate, and reliable.Product HighlightsSignature Series styling with cast aluminum frame, aluminum cone, and rubber surround — visually identical to the SS12-22 driverPassive radiator design enables deep bass extension from compact enclosures without port noiseSandwich Mass Structure (SMS) places added mass between spider and surround for stability and symmetrySimple tuning with threaded bolt, wing nut, and nylock nut for secure mass adjustmentIncludes five 116 g weights for flexible tuning optionsPerfect companion for the Dayton Audio SS12-22 in compact high output systemsProduct Manuals / Spec Sheets / DownloadsDayton Audio SS12-PR Specification SheetBuying OptionsBuy on Parts ExpressBuy Internationally
